**Discpress 1.3.7 fixes the most serious problems found by a full review of the app:** jobs that could hang or keep running after Cancel, files in your output folder that could be deleted, and games that could be built from another game's tracks.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.3.7/discpress.html)** (about 2.9 MB): the whole app in one file you keep.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad.

## Fixes

- **Cancel works from the moment you press Start.** While a job was still identifying the game or measuring the device, Cancel did nothing and the job converted anyway. Removing a job then only hid it: it kept converting in the background.
- **Removing a job no longer freezes the queue.** Removing a started job that was still waiting for identification left every other job "Queued" until the page was reloaded.
- **Your output folder is safe.** Cancelling, or a failed job, deleted a file of the same name that was already in the folder. Now a file already there is replaced only if you agree, and a cancel leaves it as it was. Two games that get the same name no longer silently overwrite each other.
- **Each game uses its own tracks.** Adding a folder of several games (Dreamcast GDIs all use `track01.bin`), a game with a missing track quietly took the same-named file from another game's folder, making a CHD of two discs. It now waits for its own file. Files of the same name, size and date in different folders are no longer taken for duplicates.
- **A damaged audio track no longer hangs Verify or Extract.** chdman 0.289 looped forever on some damaged FLAC data; it's now reported as a decompression error.
- **A helper thread that fails to start** (an iPhone short on memory, for example) stops the job with a message instead of leaving it at 0% forever.
- **Music CDs and PC discs are no longer named after a random game.** A track that happened to have the size of some game in the database was taken as that game.

The CHDs are the same as 1.3.0's.
